scope: Chosen bounded Python equivalents for dynamic WRITE formats, quoted STRING fields and scientific CNV_REAL_STR; no new native behavior claim

implementation_choices.formats: KAREL INTEGER expressions, with BYTE/SHORT promotion; up to two formats, one for BOOLEAN and none for CR; no Python eval
implementation_choices.evaluation: Each item evaluates value, width, second format once in order, then validates/renders before the next item; all item formats evaluated before range checks
implementation_choices.ranges: Numeric/BOOLEAN width 0..254; REAL precision -254..254; integer base 0 or 2..16; STRING width 0..2147483647, alignment 0..3
implementation_choices.static_checks: Signed/grouped literal formats retain translation-time range checks; other expressions have runtime type/range/initialization checks
implementation_choices.quoted: Leading blank and paired apostrophes, embedded apostrophes doubled; left/right padding outside; right-truncate contents using indivisible escaped characters
implementation_choices.tiny_width: Quoted widths 1 or 2 promote to 3 so the wrapper remains intact
implementation_choices.fallback: Width 0 or >254 selects natural rendered length for quoted STRING, contents length for unquoted STRING; no huge padding allocation
implementation_choices.real_conversion: Python float format: negative precision selects uppercase scientific with absolute fractional digits, nonnegative selects fixed; width 1..254; preserve caller-capacity blank/asterisk overflow marker
implementation_choices.report: Literal format_specifiers remain integers; dynamic entries contain expression=true and physical line/column; dynamic width/alignment/quoting policies are explicit
implementation_choices.failure: No outer request on rendering/combined-length failure; retain earlier effects/nested requests, skip later expressions after an evaluation error, unwind routine frames; no callback retry

retained_boundaries: Initialized ASCII STRING inputs <=254 characters, checked finite REALs and integral storage
Combined rendered WRITE output <=254 characters and <=1024 items, including escaped expansion
Existing type, shape, ownership, FOR-counter, call-depth and step checks
No explicit file/device access, READ, aggregate output, binary transfer or IO_STATUS
Conservative internal formatting tests remain for the future strict milestone
